messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "dangerously high opioid levels"
set: ["dangerously high opioid levels", "dangerously high fever", "dangerously high blood pressure", "dangerously high potassium level", "high calcium levels", "high vitamin D levels", "combined effect can push potassium level dangerously high", "opioid overdose", "opioid medication", "opioid agonist", "high blood levels of uric acid", "gout or high uric acid levels", "dangerously slow heartbeat", "high levels of serotonin in the body", "reverse opioid overdose", "high calcium levels or parathyroid gland disorder"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
